artifact: Crypto Radar Pro v61 · ADAPTIVE GOVERNANCE & CHAMPION-CHALLENGER PRO · AUDITED
audit_scope: inherited v54 severe matrix + v61 static/runtime governance validation; live provider/deployment validation not claimed

findings.title: Same-candle stop+target ambiguity is silently dropped in walk-forward backtest
findings.resolution: wfTrade() and paramWfTrade() resolve same-candle stop+target conflicts stop-first; runtime fixture asserts -1R and ambiguity counting.

findings.title: Multi-timeframe engine can report 100% confidence with only one surviving timeframe
findings.resolution: mtfComposite() requires >=3/4 coverage, shrinks score by coverage² and caps confidence by coverage; runtime 1-TF fixture returns NEUTRAL/25%.

findings.title: Historical CVD is accumulated before rows are sorted chronologically
findings.resolution: Historical CVD normalizes, sorts and deduplicates provider rows before cumulative delta; runtime descending fixture returns chronological rows and final CVD 130.

findings.title: Observed 7-day liquidation heatmap is effectively pruned to 30 minutes
findings.resolution: Observed liquidation memory/heatmap retains and queries 7 days; DB hydration uses 7-day cutoff.

findings.title: Stale crypto/external state can contaminate another symbol or US-stock verdict
findings.resolution: Decision state is identity-stamped by market/source/symbol/TF and invalidated on symbol/market changes; async responses are rejected when identity changed.

findings.title: Data Quality can remain high with missing MTF/context or stale mismatched states
findings.resolution: masterDataQuality() now includes MTF coverage, identity/source freshness, flow/CVD coverage, external context freshness, model staleness and stock corporate-action guard with hard caps.

findings.title: Master Verdict double-counts correlated evidence and presents a probability-like 0–100 composite
findings.resolution: Master Verdict is explicitly HEURISTIC_FAMILY_CAPPED with TECH/MODEL/FLOW/CONTEXT family caps; calibrated probability remains separate. Correlated evidence cannot be made statistically independent, so this is mitigated rather than labeled a probability.

findings.title: Monitor Worker config ships with placeholder D1/KV IDs
findings.resolution: wrangler.monitor.toml contains no placeholder IDs; configure-monitor.mjs generates deployment config from required environment IDs.

findings.title: Multiple unescaped innerHTML sinks plus no CSP/security headers
findings.resolution: Frontend JS/CSS split enables CSP; _headers sets CSP/frame/object/referrer/permissions protections; provider/error HTML sinks are escaped and audit checks known dynamic sinks.

findings.title: ML/calibration uses only the latest 250 localStorage journal rows, not the larger IndexedDB archive
findings.resolution: researchJournalArchive + researchJournalRows merge IndexedDB history with working set; ML/resolved analyses use the merged archive instead of only 250 localStorage rows.

findings.title: Frontend is a 717KB single HTML monolith with heavy main-thread research loops
findings.resolution: 717KB HTML monolith split into index.html/app.js/app.css and heavy ML/bootstrap/Monte Carlo moved to research-worker.js. app.js remains large, so maintainability risk is reduced but not eliminated.

findings.title: Whale Alert transaction pagination is not followed
findings.resolution: Whale Alert follows provider next/next_url pagination with deduplication, page cap and completeness flag.

findings.title: Training cohort depends on manually saved signals
findings.resolution: Every analysis seeds an AUTO_RESEARCH prospective cohort; user save marks/merges rather than defining the training cohort.

findings.title: Push subscription endpoint accepts unauthenticated arbitrary endpoints when Origin is absent
findings.resolution: Push write routes require APP_API_TOKEN plus strict same-origin Origin; missing-Origin runtime test returns 403.

findings.title: Paid-provider proxy endpoints are public and can burn API quota
findings.resolution: Paid/provider proxy routes require APP_API_TOKEN and rate limits; public config/health remains non-secret only.

findings.title: Monitor trigger can be invoked without Origin and receives the server monitor token
findings.resolution: Monitor trigger requires APP_API_TOKEN and strict Origin for POST; missing-Origin runtime test returns 403.

findings.title: Pionex private account data endpoint has no application authentication
findings.resolution: Pionex private account endpoint requires APP_API_TOKEN and rate limiting; runtime no/wrong token tests return 401.

findings.title: D1 history GET is public and not partitioned by user
findings.resolution: History API requires APP_API_TOKEN; D1 browser history is tenant-keyed from HISTORY_TENANT or token digest, and queries/writes filter tenant. Monitor rows remain separately tagged monitor.

findings.title: Twelve Data intraday series are unadjusted for splits but engine treats them as continuous prices
findings.resolution: Twelve Data daily path uses split-adjusted series; intraday path detects split-like discontinuities and truncates/guards contaminated history.

findings.title: IV/RV ratio compares unmatched horizons
findings.resolution: IV/RV comparison now matches RV horizon to nearest option expiry and uses maturity-specific realized volatility.

findings.title: 22 form controls are potentially unlabeled and 4 canvases lack accessible alternatives
findings.resolution: Form/button/canvas audit found no unlabeled controls; canvas alternatives/ARIA labels were added and static A11Y checks pass.

findings.title: Similar provider/scoring logic exists in browser, Pages Functions and monitor Worker
findings.resolution: ENGINE_CONTRACT_VERSION 54.1 is pinned across browser, research worker, Pages market/external functions and monitor worker with a shared contract JSON + audit invariant. Logic is still distributed, so drift risk is mitigated, not eliminated.

findings.title: Rolling examples can have overlapping future outcome windows
findings.resolution: rollingPoints() advances by the full outcome horizon and stores eventStartTs/eventEndTs, avoiding overlapping outcome windows.

findings.title: Standard Backup does not contain the full IndexedDB archive
findings.resolution: Full backup exports IndexedDB records/reports/meta in addition to working sets and wraps payload in mandatory SHA-256 integrity metadata.

findings.title: No pinned runtime/dependencies, lockfile, lint/typecheck or shipped automated test suite
findings.resolution: Node 22.x/npm 10.9.2 are pinned; package-lock and automated syntax/security/runtime/static audit scripts ship in the artifact and run via npm test/predeploy.

findings.title: Governed ensemble gives 25% weight to a PAV calibrator fit/evaluated on the full resolved sample
findings.resolution: PAV governance now uses out-of-fold diagnostics and is usable only with sufficient OOF sample and positive skill.

findings.title: D1 schema/worker has no retention pruning
findings.resolution: Cloud monitor applies configurable D1 retention pruning to monitor/history tables and records last-retention state.

findings.title: Visible “AUDITED” badge can imply live/security validation that has not occurred
findings.resolution: The release keeps the visible AUDITED badge but pairs it with an explicit `AUDIT: STATIC+RUNTIME · LIVE UNVERIFIED` scope chip and Health disclosure; DEPLOY_V54.md separately requires post-deploy live validation.

findings.title: CVD coverage uses row count, not timestamp continuity/uniqueness
findings.resolution: Historical CVD coverage uses unique timestamps, interval continuity, start/end coverage and missing-interval counts, not row count alone.

findings.title: Paper working set is capped at 200 localStorage trades
findings.resolution: Paper analytics merge the IndexedDB archive with the local working set instead of being limited to 200 localStorage trades.

findings.title: Brier-skill baseline in modelEval uses test-set prevalence
findings.resolution: Brier-skill baseline uses training/base-rate metadata per model/fold rather than test-set prevalence; worker pooled metrics use each prediction base.

findings.title: Experiment Registry has duplicate detection but no statistical correction for repeated parameter search
findings.resolution: Experiment Registry adds locked holdout, bootstrap candidate-vs-baseline difference test, Bonferroni adjustment and family trial cap.

findings.title: ML label is binary netR>0 and ignores payoff magnitude
findings.resolution: ML target is utility-aware (>=0.10R) and samples are weighted by capped absolute R utility, rather than binary netR>0 only.

findings.title: Displayed ATM IV is an ATM-band proxy, not formal forward/delta ATM
findings.resolution: Options/volatility UI now labels ATM values explicitly as ATM-band IV proxy; no formal delta/forward ATM claim.

findings.title: Coin Metrics request is limited to page_size=100 without pagination
findings.resolution: Coin Metrics follows pagination instead of relying on a single page_size=100 response.

findings.title: Historical CVD fallback skips the 30m level available to Startup plans
findings.resolution: Historical CVD fallback ladder is requested interval -> 30m -> 4h with attempts exposed.

findings.title: Whale exchange-flow classification/value are heuristic at transaction level
findings.resolution: Whale flow uses per-leg provider attribution and USD values, reports input/output exchange USD and ambiguity; ownership still depends on provider labels, so semantics remain explicitly heuristic.

findings.title: Purged walk-forward uses a fixed observation gap, not exact label-interval overlap
findings.resolution: Purged walk-forward stores exact outcome intervals and removes train labels whose outcome interval overlaps the test start; fixed gap remains only an additional buffer.

findings.title: Worker broadcasts pushes by listing all KV subscriptions and sending sequentially
findings.resolution: Push broadcast is batched with bounded concurrency instead of fully sequential per-subscription delivery.

findings.title: Garman-Klass can underrepresent overnight jump risk in stocks
findings.resolution: Stock volatility includes separate overnight-gap/intraday diagnostics so Garman-Klass is not presented as complete jump risk.

findings.title: Pionex rate coordination is not global across Cloudflare isolates
findings.resolution: Pionex proxy reserves pacing through shared D1 monitor_state when DB is bound, with local-isolate fallback. Global coordination therefore depends on the D1 binding.

findings.title: Nasdaq universe is a static snapshot dated 2026-09-18
findings.resolution: Nasdaq static snapshot now exposes age/FRESH-AGING-STALE governance and requires confirmation/warning when stale. Membership is still a snapshot until a live universe provider is configured.

findings.title: Repeated model/version experiments reuse the same chronological OOS segment
findings.resolution: Experiment development OOS excludes a locked final 15%, repeated family trials are counted/penalized, and the locked holdout is not reused for candidate selection.

findings.title: v53 volatility risk multipliers are heuristic and not OOS-validated
findings.resolution: Experimental volatility sizing is disabled by default and must be explicitly opted in; heuristic multipliers are no longer silently applied. They remain research heuristics until separately OOS-validated.

findings.title: History POST sameOrigin check also allows missing Origin
findings.resolution: History POST requires strict same-origin with Origin present; missing Origin returns 403 in runtime security test.

findings.title: Several research gates allow very small trade counts
findings.resolution: Research thresholds raised: OOS threshold selection and forward retirement require N>=20; calibration uses N>=30 calibrated / N>=20 watch; empirical setup estimates require N>=20.

findings.title: Research/account-related local data are unencrypted at rest in browser storage
findings.resolution: Optional session-only privacy mode keeps new research/model/flow/Paper state in memory and erases persistent IndexedDB/journal/Paper data. Persistent mode is intentionally still browser storage, not encrypted-at-rest.

findings.title: True trade-flow CVD uses a count-limited history, not fixed elapsed-time windows
findings.resolution: True trade-flow CVD fetches an elapsed 15-minute window over multiple aggTrades pages and records start/end coverage instead of a single count-limited page.

findings.title: Date-only stock bars are hard-coded to 20:00 UTC
findings.resolution: US-stock date-only timestamps are normalized using exchange/DST-aware session handling rather than hard-coded 20:00 UTC.

findings.title: Dashboard and Verdict Center expose 53 modules with limited progressive disclosure
findings.resolution: Verdict Center details/family/module matrix are behind progressive disclosure (<details>) with concise top-level KPIs retained.

findings.title: 1d/7d implied expected moves reuse nearest-expiry IV without term interpolation
findings.resolution: Expected moves interpolate/match IV across term structure for 1d/7d horizons instead of reusing nearest expiry IV blindly.

findings.title: US-stock intraday annualization uses approximate fixed bars/year
findings.resolution: US-stock annualization derives observed bars/year from loaded intraday cadence/session data instead of only fixed approximations.

findings.title: Command palette and More drawer lack robust dialog semantics/focus management
findings.resolution: Command palette and More drawer now use dialog semantics, aria-modal/labels, tabindex and focus helpers/return-focus behavior.

findings.title: Monitor worker /health is public
findings.resolution: Unauthenticated monitor /health now returns only {ok:true}; detailed service/config state requires MONITOR_TOKEN.

findings.title: Research checksum falls back to FNV-1a when WebCrypto is unavailable
findings.resolution: Research/backup integrity requires WebCrypto SHA-256; weak FNV fallback was removed.

findings.title: Local DB migration marker remains migration-v48 while schema is v53
findings.resolution: Migration bookkeeping uses migration-v54 and schema-migrations records covering 48..54.

findings.title: Offline mode is shell-only for most research features
findings.resolution: Offline state is explicit read-only local research mode and network-dependent actions are disabled with aria-disabled. Full online analysis is intentionally not simulated offline.

findings.title: Service-worker install uses cache.addAll for shell assets
findings.resolution: Service-worker shell install uses per-asset Promise.allSettled/cache.put so one optional asset failure does not abort all cached shell assets.

findings.title: Embedded Pionex fallback coin snapshot will age
findings.resolution: Embedded Pionex fallback snapshot exposes age/state and stale warnings; stale membership is not presented as current. Snapshot itself necessarily ages between live refreshes.

findings.title: Mixed Romanian/English terminology is pervasive
findings.resolution: A Romanian/English research glossary was added and primary explanatory text is Romanian; standard market acronyms remain English by design.

findings.title: 2σ/3σ shock counts use sample sigma and are not Gaussian tail probabilities
findings.resolution: UI now calls these empirical >2×SD/>3×SD exceedances and no longer implies Gaussian tail probabilities.

findings.title: Volatility-cone windows are heavily overlapping
findings.resolution: Volatility cone reports both overlapping and non-overlapping samples/percentiles, exposing sample dependence rather than hiding it.

Engine Contract remains 54.1 and data schema remains 54. OHLCV cannot prove real tick queue priority or exact intrabar path.
